purpose: Classify the frozen-A Dev census by Official outcome while retaining submitted-program qualification as an independent quality axis.

official_pass.definition: The exact submitted program completes EnvBench Official evaluation and Official Pass is true. Advisory qualification may independently pass or fail.

official_fail.definition: The exact submitted program completes EnvBench Official evaluation and Official Pass is false.

agent_noncompletion.definition: The Agent exhausts its operational limit, times out, or terminates without a safety-admissible submitted program, with no infrastructure censoring evidence.

infrastructure_unknown.definition: Network, provider, host suspension, source acquisition, container, or evaluator infrastructure prevents a valid Official outcome.

observation.question: Did the Agent fail to obtain or correctly read decisive execution evidence?

constraint.question: Was decisive evidence available, but converted into an incorrect or incomplete requirement or conflict?

operation.question: Was the relevant requirement understood, but the selected state transition, state reuse, or final program failed to satisfy it?

cross-layer.question: Do at least two independently necessary failures from different layers remain, with no single supported primary bottleneck?

unresolved.question: Is the available A-only evidence insufficient for a causal classification?

adjudication_rules.qualification_role: Independent advisory deployment-quality and integrity axis; it cannot overwrite a completed Official outcome.
adjudication_rules.official_followup: Every safety-admissible exact submitted program must receive Official evaluation even when advisory qualification fails.
inputs_allowed: Frozen-A exact submitted program and advisory qualification
Frozen-A Official result and residual missing imports
Repository metadata visible to Frozen A
inputs_forbidden: Whether a proposed EnvSolve-Pro change repairs the case
Official Test or Canary content and outcomes
adjudication_rules.primary_failure_rule: For Official bad cases, assign exactly one primary layer only when A-only evidence supports the earliest counterfactual bottleneck whose removal would plausibly change the Official outcome. Otherwise assign cross-layer or unresolved.
adjudication_rules.secondary_tags: Up to three frozen subtypes may be retained as secondary contributors.
adjudication_rules.evidence_requirement: Every non-unresolved failure assignment and every quality flag must cite exact A-only artifact evidence.
adjudication_rules.novel_mechanism_policy: Map to unresolved/novel-mechanism-held-for-taxonomy-v2 until the complete census is closed.

batch_selection.stratum_order: Descending census frequency, then lexical stratum identifier.
batch_selection.selection_algorithm: Round-robin over ordered nonempty strata, taking the next ranked case from each stratum until 12 unique cases are selected or all eligible cases are exhausted.
selection_inputs_forbidden: Advisory qualification outcome when Official outcome is available
Expected ease of improving a case
batch_selection.remaining_cases: All unselected eligible Official bad cases form the frozen validation pool and cannot be used to design the first core algorithm.
